answer: Sybil tax stops bulk fake identities: each new identity pays a sunk, non-refundable tax of 200 units before earning. A prism check splits each claim into payment, device, and history proofs, exposing copies. Verified identities join a trellis of referrals, and honest earnings stay in a haven pool open only to taxed identities. Faking 1,000 identities costs 200,000 units, sunk; one honest agent pays 200 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
